## 45:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "When-you-divide the-land by-lot as-an-inheritance, you-shall-set-apart a-contribution to-YHWH, a-holy portion-of the-land." |
| LOGOS | "When you allot the land as an inheritance, you shall set apart for the LORD a portion of the land as a holy district." |
| PNEUMA | "When you divide the land among the tribes of Israel, you must set aside an area for the LORD as his special portion." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
